newsitem.title: SYRIA: Eleven teachers killed in bus accident in Syria.
newsitem.headline: Eleven teachers killed in bus accident in Syria.

text.p: Eleven Syrian female school teachers, a six-year-old boy and two drivers were killed in a traffic accident in southern Syria, traffic police officials said on Thursday.

They said three other female teachers were seriously injured in the collision between a mini school bus and a Turkish truck on Wednesday near the city of Daraa, some 110 km (68 miles) south of Damascus.
The Syrian and Turkish drivers also died in the accident. The school boy victim is the son of one of the teachers.
Daraa city declared Thursday a day of mourning for its dead teachers aged between 22 and 35.
